Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 12 reps. Aim for an RPE of 7 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Contract your glutes and position your elbows under your eyes to make the plank more difficult. After no warm-up sets, do 1 set of 30s reps. Aim for an RPE of 7 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 1 total work set
Set up a comfortable arch, quick pause on the chest and explode up on each rep. After 3-4 warm-up sets, do 1 set of 2-4 reps. Aim for an RPE of 6 resting ~3-4 min between sets. 1 total work set
6 cluster sets: 3 reps, rest 15s, repeat 6x. Keep form smooth and controlled. After 2 warm-up sets, do 4 sets of 3 reps. Aim for an RPE of 6 resting ~15 sec between sets. 4 total work sets

Start with your elbows in front of you and palms facing in. Rotate the dumbbells so that your palms face forward as you press. After 2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 12 reps. Aim for an RPE of 6 resting ~2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets
10 cluster sets: 3 reps, rest 15s, repeat 10x. Keep form tight. After 2 warm-up sets, do 6 sets of 3 reps. Aim for an RPE of 6 resting ~15 sec between sets. 6 total work sets
Focus on squeezing your triceps to move the weight. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 15 reps. Aim for an RPE of 7 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Keep your elbow behind your torso throughout the range of motion, focus on squeezing your bicep. Sets are per arm. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 15 reps. Aim for an RPE of 7 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets
Brace your lats, chest tall, pull the slack out of the bar before lifting. After 3-4 warm-up sets, do 1 set of 8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 6 resting ~3-4 min between sets. 1 total work set
Medium width feet placement on the platform, don't allow your lower back to round. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 1 set of 12 reps. Aim for an RPE of 6 resting ~2-3 min between sets. 1 total work set
Focus on squeezing your quads to make the weight move. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 15 reps. Aim for an RPE of 7 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets
Focus on squeezing your hamstrings to make the weight move. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 15 reps. Aim for an RPE of 7 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Clear your upper back off the floor when you crunch, hold for 1-2 seconds and then go back down. Don't yank with your neck. After no warm-up sets, do 1 set of 15 reps. Aim for an RPE of 7 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 1 total work set
